entities.name: WWII & Switch of Sides

entities.summary: Ion Antonescu's military dictatorship, alliance with Nazi Germany, the Holocaust in Romania (Iași pogrom, Transnistria deportations — 280,000–380,000 Jews and Roma killed), and King Michael's coup (August 23, 1944) switching Romania to the Allied side.
